description: Abstract class implementing common payment method interface for Goteo platform, utilizing Omnipay library for payment processing.

classes.name: AbstractPaymentMethod
classes.description: Abstract class providing common payment method functionalities, including gateway initialization, purchase, refund, and URL generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing user and gateway.

methods.name: initGateway
methods.description: Initializes the payment gateway using Omnipay GatewayFactory and configures default parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Deprecated static method returning the payment method ID based on class name.

methods.name: getIdNonStatic
methods.description: Returns the payment method ID based on class name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the payment method.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns the description of the payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the URL of the payment method icon.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is active.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is public.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user associated with the payment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the payment.

methods.name: setInvest
methods.description: Sets the investment details for the payment.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Returns the investment object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Provides a default HTTP response after purchase completion, can be overridden.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates the payment process via gateway.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase after user returns from gateway.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Checks if the gateway supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund through the gateway.

methods.name: getCompleteUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect after payment completion.

methods.name: getInvestDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the investment for display.

methods.name: getTotalAmount
methods.description: Calculates total investment amount including donations.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway.

methods.name: getGateway
methods.description: Returns the gateway interface instance.

methods.name: calculateCommission
methods.description: Calculates bank fees based on configuration and investment data.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the payment is internal (default false).

methods.name: isSubscription
methods.description: Indicates if the payment method is a subscription (default false).
